overview.en:
Skill for looking up public GitHub repo or user stats via the unauthenticated GitHub REST API (60 req/hr/IP).

Inspect public GitHub repository and user statistics. Keep the repository or account identity and observation time attached to the summary.

Use this plugin in a Ghast conversation with the relevant inputs or project context. The bundled workflow guides the task; any required external tools or runtime must be available in your environment.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 GitHub 公开接口查询仓库与用户统计信息。

查看公开 GitHub 仓库与用户统计，在摘要中保留仓库或账号标识及观测时间。

在 Ghast 对话中提供相关输入或项目背景后使用本插件。随附流程会指导任务；所需外部工具或运行环境仍需在本机可用。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the public statistics for this GitHub repository.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个 GitHub 仓库的公开统计。

starterPrompts.en: Compare the available public statistics for these two repositories.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这两个仓库的可用公开统计。

starterPrompts.en: Review this GitHub user's public profile statistics.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看这个 GitHub 用户的公开资料统计。
